assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1143137f76b2571.text: Welcome to the Museum of Science.
The exhibition that we're about to see is called Discovering Medieval Science.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1143137f76b2571.zh: 我们马上要看的展览名为“发现中世纪科学”。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1143137f76b2571.text: As some of you may know, the Middle Ages have often been called the Dark Ages.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1143137f76b2571.zh: 如你们当中一些人所知，中世纪常被称为黑暗时代。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1143137f76b2571.text: you will find out that they were not.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1143137f76b2571.zh: 你们会发现事实并非如此。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1143137f76b2571.text: The Middle Ages were an interesting time and they were full of scientific discoveries.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1143137f76b2571.zh: 中世纪是一个有趣的时代，充满了科学发现。
来自印度的发明和技术，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1143137f76b2571.text: North Africa and the Middle East were brought to Europe.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1143137f76b2571.zh: 北非和中东的发明与技术被带到了欧洲。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1143137f76b2571.text: Inventions and machines designed by medieval scholars made a great contribution to society and many are still in use today.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1143137f76b2571.zh: 中世纪学者设计的发明和机器对社会作出了巨大贡献，其中许多至今仍在使用。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1143137f76b2571.text: And some of these inventions are very common.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1143137f76b2571.zh: 其中一些发明非常普遍。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d99b382a589cab5.text: For example, the first fountain pen was made in 953 in Africa.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d99b382a589cab5.zh: 例如，第一支钢笔于953年在非洲制造。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d99b382a589cab5.text: Before then, people used bird feathers and ink to write with.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d99b382a589cab5.zh: 在此之前，人们用鸟羽毛和墨水写字。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d99b382a589cab5.text: This method would often leave your fingers and clothes covered with black ink.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d99b382a589cab5.zh: 这种方法常会让你的手指和衣服沾满黑色墨水。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d99b382a589cab5.text: So the first fountain pen had a small container with ink inside and did not stain people's clothes or fingers while the user was writing.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d99b382a589cab5.zh: 因此，第一支钢笔有一个装墨水的小容器，使用者书写时不会弄脏衣服或手指。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d99b382a589cab5.text: You can see a model of this fountain pen in room 11b.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d99b382a589cab5.zh: 你可以在11B展厅看到这种钢笔的模型。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8173599ffd9d097.text: In the same room, you'll find early examples of glasses.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8173599ffd9d097.zh: 在同一个展厅里，你会看到早期眼镜的样品。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8173599ffd9d097.text: Glasses were invented in Italy in the 13th century.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8173599ffd9d097.zh: 眼镜于13世纪在意大利发明。
没有人知道是谁发明了它们。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8173599ffd9d097.text: The first glasses were held in front of the eyes or balanced on the nose.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8173599ffd9d097.zh: 最早的眼镜是举在眼前或架在鼻子上的。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8173599ffd9d097.text: They were developed to help people with bad vision to read.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8173599ffd9d097.zh: 它们被开发出来帮助视力不好的人阅读。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8173599ffd9d097.text: But let's now move on to some other inventions.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8173599ffd9d097.zh: 但现在让我们继续看看其他发明。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_c9da55a007fd24e.text: we have works by the great medieval engineer Al -Jazari.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_c9da55a007fd24e.zh: 我们展出了中世纪伟大工程师贾扎里的作品。
贾扎里生活在12世纪的土耳其。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_c9da55a007fd24e.text: His work, The Book of Knowledge of Ingenious Mechanical Devices, lists 100 different machines with instructions and diagrams explaining how to build them.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_c9da55a007fd24e.zh: 他的著作《巧妙机械装置知识之书》列出了100种不同机器，并附有说明和图解，讲解如何制造它们。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_c9da55a007fd24e.text: you can see models of some of the devices which were designed by Al -Jazari.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_c9da55a007fd24e.zh: 你可以看到贾扎里设计的一些装置的模型。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7ab0ea2f60853f0.text: Here you can see his mechanical clocks.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7ab0ea2f60853f0.zh: 这里可以看到他的机械钟。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7ab0ea2f60853f0.text: Water and weights make the clocks work.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7ab0ea2f60853f0.zh: 水和重物让这些钟运转。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7ab0ea2f60853f0.text: However, his most important invention was the crankshaft.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7ab0ea2f60853f0.zh: 然而，他最重要的发明是曲轴。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7ab0ea2f60853f0.text: The crankshaft is a long arm which allows machines to move in a straight line.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7ab0ea2f60853f0.zh: 曲轴是一根长臂，使机器能够作直线运动。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7ab0ea2f60853f0.text: It was first used for watering gardens and fields on farms.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7ab0ea2f60853f0.zh: 它最初被用来给花园和农田浇水。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7ab0ea2f60853f0.text: a crankshaft is used in car engines.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7ab0ea2f60853f0.zh: 曲轴被用于汽车发动机。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d3ed4bf3ad93d79.text: As we move along, you'll find one of the most important inventions of medieval times.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d3ed4bf3ad93d79.zh: 继续往前走，你会看到中世纪最重要的发明之一。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d3ed4bf3ad93d79.text: This invention has changed the history of the world in ways that we can't even imagine.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d3ed4bf3ad93d79.zh: 这项发明以我们甚至无法想象的方式改变了世界历史。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d3ed4bf3ad93d79.text: It's one of the four great inventions of Chinese culture,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d3ed4bf3ad93d79.zh: 它是中国文化四大发明之一，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d3ed4bf3ad93d79.text: Gunpowder was invented in the 9th century by Chinese scientists who were trying to create a powder which would make you live forever.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d3ed4bf3ad93d79.zh: 火药由中国科学家在9世纪发明，当时他们正试图制作一种能让人长生不老的粉末。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_37d19d65ed51153.text: but their attempts led to the invention of fireworks and weapons.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_37d19d65ed51153.zh: 但他们的尝试促成了烟花和武器的发明。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_37d19d65ed51153.text: The first instructions on how to make gunpowder were written in the 11th century by Zeng Gongliang,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_37d19d65ed51153.zh: 最早的火药制作说明由曾公亮在11世纪写成，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_37d19d65ed51153.text: Ding Du and Yang Wei De.

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_37c40f757f88e3d.text: The invention of gunpowder has changed the way we fight wars.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_37c40f757f88e3d.zh: 火药的发明改变了我们的战争方式。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_37c40f757f88e3d.text: It changed the outcome of many medieval battles and affected the history of the world.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_37c40f757f88e3d.zh: 它改变了许多中世纪战役的结果，并影响了世界历史。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_37c40f757f88e3d.text: Many people think gunpowder is the most important invention in history.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_37c40f757f88e3d.zh: 许多人认为火药是历史上最重要的发明。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_37c40f757f88e3d.text: Now, let's move to the next room, which is all about medieval medicine.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_37c40f757f88e3d.zh: 现在，让我们前往下一个展厅，那里全部介绍中世纪医学。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.text: I'd like to start by talking a little bit about the first apps.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.zh: 我想先简单谈谈最早的应用程序。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.text: These were included with each smartphone.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.zh: 每部智能手机都会附带这些应用程序。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.text: These types of apps were placed in the phones to help users access the internet,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.zh: 这类应用被装在手机中，帮助用户上网，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.text: check emails,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.zh: 查收电子邮件，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.text: send texts, and so on.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.zh: 发送短信，等等。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.text: The first apps were designed to increase efficiency at work and allow people to access important information.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.zh: 最早的应用程序旨在提高工作效率，并让人们获取重要信息。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.text: However,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.zh: 不过，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.text: it was the second generation of apps that really changed things.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.zh: 真正带来改变的是第二代应用程序。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.text: These were downloadable apps.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.zh: 这些是可以下载的应用程序。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.text: Users simply downloaded apps from the internet and installed them on their phones.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.zh: 用户只需从互联网下载应用程序并安装在手机上。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.text: Since its introduction, the app market has grown far beyond anyone's expectations.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.zh: 自推出以来，应用程序市场的增长远远超出任何人的预期。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.text: The first app store was opened in 2008.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.zh: 第一家应用商店于2008年开张。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.text: it was reporting over ten billion downloads,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.zh: 其下载量已超过100亿次，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.text: and people were using apps more than internet browsers on their phones.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.zh: 而且人们在手机上使用应用程序的时间已经多于使用互联网浏览器。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.text: And by 2017,
an estimated 180 billion apps had been downloaded.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.zh: 估计已有1800亿个应用程序被下载。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.text: These numbers have been growing ever since,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.zh: 这些数字从那时起一直在增长，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.text: and they give us a good idea about how popular apps are and how quickly they've developed.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.zh: 它们让我们清楚了解了应用程序有多受欢迎，以及其发展速度有多快。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.text: People from all over the world use apps for entertainment, travel, and communication.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.zh: 世界各地的人们都用应用程序娱乐、旅行和交流。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.text: So I'm going to briefly talk about how these apps have changed our lives.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.zh: 所以，我将简要谈谈这些应用程序如何改变了我们的生活。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.text: It's hard to imagine life before smartphones and mobile phone apps,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.zh: 很难想象智能手机和手机应用程序出现前的生活，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.text: or for those of us who are old enough to remember it, but let's go ahead and make an attempt anyway.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.zh: 对那些年纪够大、还记得那时生活的人来说也是如此，不过我们还是来试着想象一下。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.text: So imagine for a moment that you're taking a road trip in the days before smartphones.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.zh: 那么，想象一下，在智能手机出现前的时代，你正要开车旅行。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.text: Weeks before the trip,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.zh: 旅行前几周，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.text: you go to the bookstore or library to get some guidebooks about the places you're going to visit.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.zh: 你会去书店或图书馆找一些关于目的地的旅游指南。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.text: A few days before you leave,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.zh: 出发前几天，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.text: you get some audiobooks to entertain you during the long trip.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.zh: 你会准备一些有声书，在漫长的旅途中娱乐自己。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.text: You go to a shop and buy some maps.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.zh: 你去商店买几张地图。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.text: Yes,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.zh: 是的，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.text: the paper kind.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.zh: 纸质的那种。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.text: The day before the trip, you sit down at your computer and look up the directions and print them out.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_809db4f5fdbdeca.zh: 出行前一天，你坐在电脑前查询路线并把它打印出来。

an estimated 180 billion apps had been downloaded.

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_298f653571e21d4.zh: 那么，想象一下，在智能手机出现前的时代，你正要开车旅行。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_298f653571e21d4.text: Weeks before the trip,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_298f653571e21d4.zh: 旅行前几周，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_298f653571e21d4.text: you go to the bookstore or library to get some guidebooks about the places you're going to visit.

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_298f653571e21d4.text: Then you pack some of your favorite CDs to bring along.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_298f653571e21d4.zh: 然后你会打包几张自己喜欢的光盘带上。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_298f653571e21d4.text: You also pack your camera and your torch in case your car breaks down.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_298f653571e21d4.zh: 你还会带上相机和手电筒，以防汽车抛锚。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_298f653571e21d4.text: And you write down some phone numbers and addresses of the friends you'll be visiting and the hotels where you'll be staying.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_298f653571e21d4.zh: 你会记下将要拜访的朋友的电话号码和地址，以及将要入住酒店的地址。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_298f653571e21d4.text: While you're driving,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_298f653571e21d4.zh: 开车时，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_298f653571e21d4.text: your passenger reads the directions to you and looks for street signs.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_298f653571e21d4.zh: 你的乘客会为你读路线，并留意路牌。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_298f653571e21d4.text: If you get lost, you stop at a petrol station to ask for directions.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_298f653571e21d4.zh: 如果迷路了，你会在加油站停下来问路。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_298f653571e21d4.text: You have to write them down on a piece of paper.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_298f653571e21d4.zh: 你必须把路线写在一张纸上。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_298f653571e21d4.text: Now, let's make a comparison with the same trip today.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_298f653571e21d4.zh: 现在，让我们把它和今天的同一趟旅行作个比较。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_298f653571e21d4.text: No
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_298f653571e21d4.zh: 没有人，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_298f653571e21d4.zh: 地图，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_298f653571e21d4.text: no
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_298f653571e21d4.zh: 没有

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_298f653571e21d4.text: CDs,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_298f653571e21d4.zh: 光盘，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_298f653571e21d4.text: no
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_298f653571e21d4.zh: 没有

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_298f653571e21d4.text: lists of phone numbers,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_298f653571e21d4.zh: 电话号码清单，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_298f653571e21d4.text: no
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_298f653571e21d4.zh: 没有

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_298f653571e21d4.text: friend giving you directions.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_298f653571e21d4.zh: 也不需要朋友给你指路。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_298f653571e21d4.text: The smartphone does it all.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_298f653571e21d4.zh: 智能手机全都能办到。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_298f653571e21d4.text: Think of the apps you'd use just for that one trip.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_298f653571e21d4.zh: 想想仅为了这一次旅行你会使用哪些应用程序。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_59a6320b7e701e2.text: Of course, a music app would replace the CDs and you could listen to podcasts as well as audiobooks.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_59a6320b7e701e2.zh: 当然，音乐应用会代替光盘，你也可以听播客和有声书。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_59a6320b7e701e2.text: And of course, you wouldn't need to bring a camera or a torch.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_59a6320b7e701e2.zh: 当然，你也不需要带相机或手电筒。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_59a6320b7e701e2.text: Yes, we've certainly made a lot of progress since the pre -smartphone days.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_59a6320b7e701e2.zh: 是的，自智能手机出现前的时代以来，我们确实取得了很大进步。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_59a6320b7e701e2.text: now I'd like to mention another important effect of the invention of apps.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_59a6320b7e701e2.zh: 现在，我想提及应用程序发明带来的另一个重要影响。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_59a6320b7e701e2.text: It has created a whole new IT sector.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_59a6320b7e701e2.zh: 它创造了一个全新的信息技术行业。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_59a6320b7e701e2.text: It is one of the fastest growing industries and there is a great need for skilled software engineers.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_59a6320b7e701e2.zh: 这是发展最快的行业之一，对熟练的软件工程师有很大需求。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_59a6320b7e701e2.text: But apps have also had some negative effects.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_59a6320b7e701e2.zh: 但应用程序也带来了一些负面影响。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_59a6320b7e701e2.text: For one thing, people have become more helpless because they're so dependent on their phones for information.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_59a6320b7e701e2.zh: 一方面，人们因过度依赖手机获取信息而变得更无助。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_59a6320b7e701e2.text: For example, if they're in a place with
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_59a6320b7e701e2.zh: 例如，如果他们在一个有

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_59a6320b7e701e2.text: phone signal, they're not very good at asking for and following directions.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_59a6320b7e701e2.zh: 手机信号的地方，他们不太擅长询问和遵循路线。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_59a6320b7e701e2.text: And apps have made people less patient because they expect to have information immediately.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_59a6320b7e701e2.zh: 而且应用程序让人们更缺乏耐心，因为他们期待立即获得信息。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_59a6320b7e701e2.text: a recent study found that 87 % of smartphone users leave a web page if it doesn't load in two seconds.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_59a6320b7e701e2.zh: 事实上，一项近期研究发现，87%的智能手机用户如果网页两秒内没有加载出来，就会离开该网页。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_59a6320b7e701e2.text: in the next part of the lecture,
I'll discuss some of the most common apps in more details.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_59a6320b7e701e2.zh: 我将更详细地讨论一些最常见的应用程序。
